messages:
Alex: pushed a follow-up to fix the allocator edge case in PR #9211 — addressed NilCheck and the race Tim pointed out. PTAL when you have a minute: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-inference/pull/9211
Jia: thanks — will take a look in ~30. Is this still a behavioral change or just a safety guard?
Alex: just a guard. behavior unchanged unless the allocator returns nil which it could in the stress path. added a unit and a small concurrency test.
Noah: can you paste the failing stacktrace you were seeing earlier? want to sanity-check the fix matches the symptoms.
Alex: pasted below:
```
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address
goroutine 7323 [running]:
  runtime.throw(0x1234ab)
  ...
```
Reproducer in tests/allocation/race_test.go, line ~42.
Jia: ok that aligns. left one tiny nit in the test name (suggest clearer wording). otherwise LGTM.
Alex: good catch, fixed and force-pushed. also squashed the minor lint commit into the fix. question: squash or keep history for this PR? I'm fine either way.
Sam: given it's a single small fix, squash is fine. but hold merge until smoke passes and canary slot is available.
Noah: CI looks green so far. can we run the smoke suite? Alex, you can trigger with `./scripts/run_smoke.sh --fast` or I can kick it.
Alex: kicked it, output: `./scripts/run_smoke.sh --fast`
ci-bot: smoke (fast) started on runner-12, job id 784332.
ci-bot: smoke (fast) passed — 12 tests, 0 failures. artifacts: https://ci.redwood.ai/artifacts/784332
Jia: ok this looks safe. I left an approval.
Noah: LGTM from my side as well.
deploy-bot: Canary slot available tomorrow 09:30 UTC. Would you like me to schedule canary 09:30 and fallback window 10:30?
Alex: yes please schedule it. if canary shows no regressions we can merge at 10:45.
Sam: note: if we hit any perf regressions during canary, rollback policy is automatic 30m, but tag me immediately.
Alex: will do. re-requesting final eyes @Jia @Noah — addressed comments and smoke passed, PTAL for merge.
Jia: LGTM :thumbsup:
Noah: ack. merge after canary window if green.
Alex: thanks all — squashed+pushed as `fix/alloc-nil-9211`. merging after canary unless anyone raises blocking concerns.
Sam: thanks, scheduling confirmed. :calendar:
ci-bot: merge-precheck passed, changelog entry present.
Alex: noted. will follow up in release notes.
